per_view.notes: Slender grey tube with rounded nose and upswept tail; tall navy swept fin plus a light horizontal stabilizer. Engine nacelles cluster low under the belly rather than clearly slung under wings on pylons; hard to count four. Small subtle front hump. Nose gear plus a 4-wheel main truck visible. Thin window dot-line present. An odd blue horizontal stripe runs through the rear fuselage.

Slender white tube with blue cheatline, dark blue swept fin, and horizontal stabs at tail. Window dots and cockpit visible. Nose gear plus a main-gear bogie present. But no distinct front cockpit hump; a raised boxy block sits mid-upper fuselage instead. Engines under wing indistinct—count unclear, edge-on wing reads as a dark slab. Some parts appear detached/blocky.

Head-on: four dark nacelles hung two-per-side under swept, slightly dihedral wings. Rounded white nose, tall blue vertical fin, thin horizontal stabilizer. Nose plus clustered main-gear trucks visible below. Only a faint crown bump for the hump; no window/door lines visible. Coherent white/grey/blue livery, clean assembly.

Rear axial view: round grey fuselage blob, four nacelles two per swept wing, main+nose gear clusters below. Vertical fin is a thin dark-blue stick, thin horizontal stabilizer. No windows/doors visible. Hump not assessable from behind. Coherent grey/blue but plain; fin looks crude and stick-like.

Top-down: four dark nacelles, two per swept tapering wing, sitting near/atop the wing rather than clearly forward-slung on pylons. Slender tapering fuselage with a raised crown near the nose. Swept horizontal stabilizers present. Faint dashed window/door hints only. A stray dark-blue line protrudes straight aft from the tail, reading as a floating artifact. Grey wings/engines, light fuselage.

Slender tapering fuselage with front hump reads as 747. Swept wings show dihedral and taper, tall dark-blue fin plus horizontal stabilizers. Window line and blue cheatline present. Engine nacelles appear clustered near the belly/fuselage rather than cleanly four on underwing pylons; some intersect gear. Landing gear wheels visible below. Light fuselage, grey wings coherent.

Slender white fuselage with blue cheatline, dotted window band, front upper-deck hump, tall swept dark-blue fin and horizontal stabs. Swept gray wings with dihedral. Four cylindrical nacelles present but clustered close to the fuselage/body, poorly spaced and reading as floating rather than pylon-slung under the wings. Multiple main-gear bogies visible under belly.

Front hump reads clearly; slender tapered fuselage, swept wings with dihedral, tall blue swept fin. Grey/blue livery coherent. Engine nacelles hard to count and cluster confusingly with the main-gear bogies mid-body; some parts appear intersecting. Window band and doors faintly present.

Slender grey fuselage, rounded nose, blue swept tail with horizontal stabilizers, blue cheatline and dashed window band. Wings swept with dihedral; multiple underslung nacelles though spacing is irregular. Upper-deck hump reads as a translucent see-through wireframe patch on the crown, a clear hole/z-fighting defect. Abundant landing gear visible.

critic.fix_suggestion: Improve 'Window and door lines' (mean 5/10). Target the 8 anchor: a consistent passenger-window line along the main deck plus cockpit windows, door hints; then the 10 anchor: clean main-deck window line, separate upper-deck windows on the hump, cockpit windshield shape, evenly spaced doors.
